subject.baseline_contract_ref: legalbenchmarks/delta v1.1.0-era public task referenced by issue #2

trigger.summary: S-009 is conditional on an answer raising dynamic interpretation, but the task does not require that argument and the inactive case is undefined.

delta_units.before: PASS insofar as the answer discusses dynamic interpretation and correctly explains the doctrine; the inactive case is unspecified.
delta_units.after: PASS if the answer does not discuss dynamic interpretation, or, if it does, correctly explains that dynamic interpretation is not an independent standard.

evidence.owner_ref: DELTA task prompt, S-009 text and cross-judge disagreement reported in issue #2
evidence.proposition: The written criterion has no determinate grading semantics when the answer does not raise dynamic interpretation.

actions: Define the inactive/vacuous case explicitly, or revise the task so the conditional argument is actually elicited.

result_impact.scope: Outputs previously scored under the ambiguous S-009 criterion.
result_impact.reason: Different judges can assign opposite verdicts when the condition does not fire; pre/post criterion scores are not comparable without re-judging.

open_questions: Which repair formulation the DELTA maintainer would prefer.

adjudication.note: Public dispute exists; no accepted upstream repair is assumed.
